snippet.title: Kick @ Convergence Showcase - Release Date Shift: Nov 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3760370/Kick/

With pedestrians to dodge, and obstacles to avoid, Kick challenges players to master the art of soccer ball physics - kicking the ball at just the right angle to ensure their trick lands exactly how they planned. 

From bustling streets and scenic beaches to shaded underpasses and sprawling parks, Kick’s story takes players on a journey through The Kid’s morning as they spend time practicing their skills in the park, run a little faster to catch the train, and take well trodden shortcuts to shave much needed seconds off their travel time.

Follow Kick!
